frame.name: data
frame.prompt: Select data to copy and clear MISSING VALUES

options.option: If a row in your selection contains any missing data, treat the entire row as missing (incomplete record)
Do not match rows, just delete all individual missing values

double.name: missing-double
double.rubric: The internal missing number value is 3E+300. You may define an additional missing number for clearing (leave the box blank if none).

string.name: missing-text
string.rubric: The internal missing text codes are: spaces, asterisk (*), point (.) and the words "missing", "#NULL!" and "#NUM!". You may define an additional missing text code for clearing (leave the box blank if none).
